arabic text: SHEH KA SAR KATA, RAN MEI BEKHATA, BINTE FATEMA DAR BADAR PHIRI\nWA MUHAMADA WA MUSIBATA BINTE FATEMA DAR BADAR PHIRI
english translation text: O MUHAMMAD, WHAT A TRAGEDY – THE DAUGHTERS OF FATIMA ARE BEING PARADED IN THE STREETS\nIMAM WAS INNOCENTLY BEHEADED IN THE BATTLEFIELD – THE DAUGHTERS OF FATIMA ARE BEING PARADED IN THE STREETS

arabic text: DEKH KAR JISE, MEHR TAK CHUPE, BE RIDA KARE AY FALAK USSE\nROOHE MUSTAFA, JAANE MURTAZA, BINTE FATEMA DAR BADAR PHIRI
english translation text: THE ONE WHO WAS THE DEFINITION OF MODESTY HAD HER VEIL TAKEN OFF\nTHE SOUL OF THE PROPHET, BELOVED OF ALI – THE DAUGHTERS OF FATIMA ARE BEING PARADED IN THE STREETS

arabic text: SAR PE SHEH NAHI, MUJTABA NAHI, MURTAZA NAHI MUSTAFA NAHI\nHO KE BE NAWA, KYU NA PHIR BHALA, BINTE FATEMA DAR BADAR PHIRI
english translation text: NOBODY IS LEFT AROUND HUSSAIN, HASAN, ALI OR THE PROPHET\nBEING ALONE, WHY SHOULDN’T SHE WEEP – THE DAUGHTERS OF FATIMA ARE BEING PARADED IN THE STREETS

arabic text: ZALZALE MEI HO, KYU NA NAINAWA, KYU NA PHIR HILE DASHTE KERBALA!\nHAAYE FAUJ KI, CHHEEN LE RIDA, BINTE FATEMA DAR BADAR PHIRI
english translation text: WHY SHOULDN’T THE LAND OF KARBALA SHAKE AND TREMBLE\nTHE OPPRESSORS ARE REMOVING THE VEILS FROM THE LADIES – THE DAUGHTERS OF FATIMA ARE BEING PARADED IN THE STREETS
